summary: Wired storage states into Playwright config for role-based E2E testing with pre-authenticated states

key_changes: Added 5 role-specific projects (pharmacist, nurse, patient, doctor, delivery) to playwright.config.ts
Each project references its corresponding storage state file from .auth/{role}.json
Storage states contain mock authentication tokens and user data generated by global-setup.ts
Tests can now run with pre-authenticated state using --project={role} flag
Maintained backward compatibility with existing browser projects for unauthenticated tests

tests.details: Created and ran verification test confirming storage state is applied correctly with auth tokens in localStorage. Test passed showing mock_access_token_nurse and mock_refresh_token_nurse are loaded from storage state.

concerns: The nurse-login-dashboard.spec.ts tests are failing because they expect nurse-specific UI components that don't exist yet (this is expected - storage state wiring is complete, UI implementation is separate)
Storage state configuration is working correctly as verified by the successful test showing auth tokens are loaded

verification.result: Storage state successfully applied - auth tokens present in localStorage without login step
verification.evidence: Verification test passed: auth_token=mock_access_token_nurse, refresh_token=mock_refresh_token_nurse, user.role=nurse
